name: Rotate-Tiling (RT) Method
definition: A sort-last parallel volume rendering compositing method where the number of processors (P) and initial blocks (N) are arbitrary positive integers. It composites partial images by organizing processors into rings for each block, performing pairwise compositing, and then partitioning blocks.
summary: The Rotate-Tiling method is a parallel volume rendering compositing algorithm that allows arbitrary processor counts and initial image blocks, unlike the Block-Splitting method which requires powers of two.
